mapper.select: select e.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.use_yn from mst_equip e where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} order by e.use_yn desc, e.equip_cd
mapper.sql: select c.count_id, c.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, c.metric_cd, c.qty, c.entry_method, t.terminal_cd as collector_cd, c.event_id, c.reason, c.occurred_at, c.recorded_at, c.recorded_by, c.reversal_of_id, r.count_id as reversed_by_id, case when c.reversal_of_id is not null then 'REVERSAL' when r.count_id is not null then 'CORRECTED' else 'NORMAL' end as state from cms_equip_count c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id left join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = c.terminal_id left join cms_equip_count r on r.reversal_of_id = c.count_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from cms_equip_count c join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = c.equip_id

insert into cms_equip_count (comp_cd, equip_id, metric_cd, qty, terminal_id, event_id, reason, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, reversal_of_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{o.equipId}, #{o.metricCd}, #{qty}, null, null, #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, 'CORRECT', #{by}, #{o.countId}) returning count_id
